<objective>
Complete owner authentication so signup/login truly needs no manual help: add Google One Tap (with a real accounts-row + consent path for first-time Google owners), a full password-reset flow proven against the local mail server, and the minimal multi-venue switcher that satisfies ACCT-03's "schema full, UI minimal" (D-15).

**User story (MVP):** **As a** restaurant owner, **I want to** recover a lost password, sign in with Google, and hop between my venues, **so that** nothing about getting into my account ever requires a support ticket.

Purpose: Plan 01 shipped the thinnest signup happy path. ACCT-01 ("without any manual help") and ACCT-03 (multi-venue) need the recovery path, the social-login option (with consent parity), and the venue switcher to be real.
Output: password-reset flow, Google One Tap + ensureAccount consent path, venue switcher, and client-SDK tests proving recovery, Google consent provisioning, and no cross-owner venue leak.

Requirements covered: ACCT-01, ACCT-03.
</objective>

<threat_model>
## Trust Boundaries

| Boundary | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| Browser → Auth server | Reset requests and Google credentials cross into session issuance |
| Client → PostgREST (anon key) | Switcher reads venues + ensureAccount calls the RPC; RLS + in-RPC authority scope them |

## STRIDE Threat Register

| Threat ID | Category | Component | Severity | Disposition | Mitigation Plan |
|-----------|----------|-----------|----------|-------------|-----------------|
| T-02-01 | Information Disclosure | password-reset request | medium | mitigate | Uniform response regardless of account existence (no enumeration oracle); asserted in login-reset test |
| T-02-02 | Spoofing | Google One Tap token | high | mitigate | Hashed nonce bound to the request + `signInWithIdToken` verifies the Google ID token server-side via Supabase Auth; FedCM prompt |
| T-02-03 | Information Disclosure | VenueSwitcher venue list | high | mitigate | Switcher reads via RLS-scoped membership; multi-venue test asserts no cross-owner leak |
| T-02-04 | Repudiation | Google-owner consent | medium | mitigate | First-time Google owner records Terms & Privacy consent via ensure_account before the session creates data; create_venue raises without an accounts row (parity with email signup) |
</threat_model>
